1.explanation: The source file src/dialog/dialog.jsx renders the Dialog’s Overlay and its inner content but does not wrap the inner content with a ConfigProvider whose popupContainer is set to the overlay node. In the compiled lib version (lib/dialog/dialog.js) you can see the extra <ConfigProvider popupContainer={getPopupContainer}> wrapper around the inner content. Without that wrapper in the src version, nested floating components (like DatePicker’s calendar) won’t use the Dialog’s overlay node as their container and will fall back to the default, causing the popupContainer setting to have no effect on Dialog.
1.bug_scenario: A ConfigProvider with popupContainer set to a specific scrollable div is wrapping a Dialog. Inside the Dialog content there’s a DatePicker. When opening the Dialog and then opening the DatePicker, the calendar popup does not render inside the specified “test” container, but instead attaches to the default container (typically document.body). As a result, when the outer container scrolls, the calendar popup is mispositioned or clipped, as shown in the screenshot.
